scope: Post hoc descriptive sensitivity of existing issue-only removed-base-line localization scores after filtering by independently observed original regression-label qualification. Already exposed development tasks, not new holdout/primary/pre-data preregistration. No SUT, new retrieval, tuning, model execution or generated repair.

original_primary_immutable.rule: Keep all39 primary results and all702 cells unchanged and visible. Never replace original primary with subset. Read existing scalar score cells only, no prediction/target rescoring or source/dataset patch text needed by standalone sensitivity script.

final_execution_snapshot_gate.rule: For each task, choose most recent approved STARTED condition by protocol_frozen_utc, run_id, condition_key. Unstarted proposal/candidate is not an execution attempt and never displaces an actual attempt. Include later failed, aborted or partial started attempts; never fall back to earlier favorable condition.
final_execution_snapshot_gate.finality: No started condition may remain running or unresolved at snapshot freeze. Closed failed/aborted conditions with incomplete pair records remain included as nonqualified. Final snapshot must explicitly classify every original39task and bind all retained started condition records and public/source-provenance validation.
final_execution_snapshot_gate.membership: Include in secondary subset if and only if the selected latest approved started closed condition is finite_qualified under the root frozen original-F2P/P2P qualification contract. No method score, rank, query, target count, method-specific success or environment best-result enters eligibility.
final_execution_snapshot_gate.finite_qualified_meaning: All original F2P labels observed as actual behavioral base-failure→fixed-pass and every original P2P actual pass in both roles, complete identity/protocol bindings and no missing/skip used as pass, under root qualification contract. Known weak assertions/early returns/mocks remain limits. Do not infer qualification merely from pytest return0 or dependency/compile checks.
final_execution_snapshot_gate.no_condition: No actual started condition means nonqualified, retained in all39 membership ledger and exclusion reasons.
final_execution_snapshot_gate.required_binding: Root creates immutable final eligibility ledger plus seal SHA before calculation. Snapshot/version/contract/source/protocol hashes and original task identity mapping must match; missing/duplicate/extra/ambiguous records cause rejection, not silent filtering.

final_eligibility_ledger_interface.selection_tie_break: max(UTC protocol_frozen_utc, run_id, condition_key) among approved started conditions; duplicate identity rejected. Rule uses no score. Unknown/malformed times rejected.
final_eligibility_ledger_interface.sealing: CLI must require explicit expected SHA256 for protocol, eligibility ledger and root approval record; reject _CURRENT mutable input name or ledger finality false. Root final seal separately binds immutable final evidence and contract. No repeated calculations over changing snapshots.

metrics.unit: Task within repository, then equal weight per repository with defined task-level label metric; not independent test nodes or retries.
metrics.task_measures: Use frozen original per-task cell integers and values. With targetT>0, recall=intersection/T and F1=2*intersection/(predicted+T); preserve original conservative zero predictions/failures. Empty-target no_target yields undefined/null for F1/recall, never zero.
metrics.within_repo: Arithmetic mean over eligible tasks having targetT>0 for that repository; identical paired task set for all methods/budgets.
metrics.repo_macro: Arithmetic mean of defined repository means. Repository with zero targetable eligible tasks is explicitly undefined/null and is not assigned0. Always show actual contributing repository count/list.
metrics.integrity: Exactly39task identities x6frozen methods x3budgets. Duplicate/missing/extra cells, nonfinite numbers, noninteger/negative counts, impossible intersections, inconsistent targets across methods/budgets or stored metric disagreement>1e-12 reject calculation. No silent deletion/imputation.
metrics.arithmetic: Use integer counts and exact rational means for signs/differences; report original numeric values checked within1e-12 and JSON finite floats plus optional exact fractions. No epsilon tuned after results.
metrics.targetability: target>0 with status=scored. status=no_target must have target0 and all three metric fields null. Unsupported/missing labels retained as undefined with explicit reason; original702 expected cell completeness is strict.
metrics.budgets_appendix: Report all8000/16000/32000 budgets and all6methods with same membership, F1/recall and denominator audit; focus budget16000 cannot change after results. File metrics/byte diagnostics stay available in unchanged original primary bundle, not promoted selectively.

mandatory_outputs.all39_reference: Exact original frozen all39 summary SHA and unchanged tables retained; independent consistency recomputation may validate but never overwrite source.
mandatory_outputs.membership_ledger: All39 identifiers with repo, original task counts, latest approved started condition key, finite-qualified boolean, final status/exclusion reasons and label targetable/no_target/missing states.
mandatory_outputs.comparisons: At16000bytes both paired baseline differences for F1 and recall, each repo effect and repo win/tie/loss/undefined count. Report mixed/negative/positive outcomes transparently.
mandatory_outputs.composition_diagnostic: Predeclared appendix: also compute all39 reference restricted only to the same contributing repository set as the qualified subset, retaining every original targetable task within those repositories. This separates repository composition from within-repo task filtering descriptively; neither is causal or replacesall39primary.
mandatory_outputs.traceability: run_id, exact executed command, UTC timestamp, interpreter/version/platform, analysis program SHA, approved protocol SHA, final ledger SHA, all original data/source hashes and every input validation status.

interpretation_rules.negative_persistence: For each baseline separately, negative F1 persists iff qualified-subset repo-macro graph-minus-baseline F1<0, negative recall persists iff recall delta<0. Exactly0 is tie/nonpositive and reported separately; undefined cannot establish either sign. Joint persistence across both baselines requires allfour F1/recall differences negative; also report every component, not only joint label.
interpretation_rules.no_inference: No p-values, significance, task-independent confidence intervals, SOTA, mature-research, downstream quality or model-repair success claim. Six original repositories and fewer represented subset repositories are clustered and imbalanced.
interpretation_rules.selection_bias: Qualification is post hoc and dependent on local CPU/platform/dependency/assets, tests and prior failures; method-independent eligibility does not remove selection bias or establish a fresh heldout distribution. Original scores/results and partial execution outcomes were already observed before this secondary protocol.
interpretation_rules.source_vs_retrieval: Passing original source regression labels does not show retrieved context is necessary/sufficient, retrieval improves generated patches, or an agent can repair. Removed patch lines remain a localization proxy.
interpretation_rules.test_count_limits: 87F2P and5842P2P are supplied test-node labels, not independent tasks/replicates/sample size; preserve39task denominator and perrepo counts. Repeated environments/phase observations are not additional independent samples.
interpretation_rules.no_threshold_reinterpretation: Do not reuse original confirmatory-advance thresholds as a maturity claim or choose the best environment/budget/subset. Any future change requires separately versioned amendment and preserved old outputs.
